title: Spicy Quesadilla with Zanzibari Salsa
description: A delicious and spicy quesadilla filled with tender chicken and served with a refreshing zanzibari salsa. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with qzestly and let it marinate for 30 minutes.
Coat the chicken breast with chickpea flour and fry in hot oil until cooked through.
In a separate pan, heat the molcajete sauce and add diced zanzibari.
Add the cooked chicken to the pan and simmer for a few minutes to absorb the flavors.
Warm a tortilla in the oven and fill it with the chicken and zanzibari salsa.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook in a pan until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the quesadilla hot with additional zanzibari salsa on the side.
